name: McDonald's Plain Hamburger (Meat & Bun Only)
whyItWorks: McDonald's 10:1 beef patties are 100% pure USDA-inspected beef seasoned only with a pinch of salt and pepper after grilling. Ordered plain on the standard soft white bun, it is entirely free of dairy, onions, pickles, and acidic tomato paste.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order at the speaker: "One regular hamburger, totally PLAIN. No onions, no pickles, no mustard, no ketchup—meat and bun only."
